title: Earthy Light Mediterranean Chives Borek
description: Indulge in this earthy and light Mediterranean borek featuring the delicate flavor of chives, all while enjoying the unique charm of cooking in a ttukbaegi earthenware cookware. This gluten-free-friendly dish is perfect for a quick weeknight meal.
instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware cookware to 375 degrees Fahrenheit (190 degrees Celsius).
Line the cookware with parchment paper, leaving some overhang for easy removal.
Roll out the filo dough to a thickness of about 1/16 inch (1.5 mm).
Cut the dough into square sheets, about 4 inches (10 cm) per side.
Place a sheet of dough in the cookware, brushing with some of the olive oil.
Spread a quarter of the chive mixture on the dough, leaving a 1-inch (2.5 cm) border around the edges.
Sprinkle a quarter of the feta cheese, kalamata olives, artichoke hearts, sun-dried tomatoes, and garlic over the chive mixture.
Fold the edges of the dough over the filling, pressing gently to seal.
Repeat the process with the remaining dough and filling ingredients, forming 4-6 boreks in total.
Brush the tops of the boreks with the remaining olive oil and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow the boreks to cool for a few minutes before serving, garnished with additional chives if desired.
Serve warm, ideally with a side of mixed greens salad for a well-rounded meal.
